alerts.title: Creatinine monitoring overdue while on TDF
alerts.message: Creatinine last recorded 478 days ago for a patient on TDF. Consider ordering repeat renal function monitoring.

alerts.title: Overdue renal monitoring for TDF
alerts.message: Guidelines state that for experienced patients on TDF, serum creatinine and eGFR should be performed every 12 months. The patient's last creatinine test was 478 days ago, which exceeds the annual monitoring interval. No renal function test is documented in the clinician's plan for this routine follow-up visit.

evidence.recommended_action: Perform serum creatinine and eGFR test as per the 12-month monitoring schedule for TDF.

alerts.title: Plan missing next viral load schedule
alerts.message: Guidelines for adults state viral load should be monitored every one year after the initial tests. The patient's last viral load was 113 days ago. While this is within a year, the clinician's plan for a routine follow-up does not mention scheduling the next annual test, creating a potential gap in future monitoring.

evidence.recommended_action: Schedule the next annual viral load test to ensure continuous yearly monitoring.
